# TypoShift key reference

<!-- Generated by tools/generate_docs.py. Do not edit. -->

Use this only when the `typoshift` CLI is unavailable. Each table pairs the character a layout produces with the English (US) character on the same physical key, unshifted and with Shift. To reconstruct English typed on layout X, replace each X character with its English pair. To reconstruct X typed on English, go the other way.

## Hebrew (Standard, SI-1452) (`he`) ↔ English (US)

| Level | he → en-US |
| --- | --- |
| Base | ;→`` ` `` /→q '→w ק→e ר→r א→t ט→y ו→u ן→i ם→o פ→p ]→[ [→] ש→a ד→s ג→d כ→f ע→g י→h ח→j ל→k ך→l ף→; ,→' ז→z ס→x ב→c ה→v נ→b מ→n צ→m ת→, ץ→. .→/ |
| Shift | )→( (→) }→{ {→} >→< <→> |
